slice: C5: terminal Boolean branches and constant interval idioms
observed: C4's frozen 48-object census found 109 terminal CMP/CSET/Boolean-branch windows and 25 two-compare Boolean combinations in current B/unchecked library objects. All 25 combinations are inclusive intervals on one value with ordered nonnegative imm12 endpoints (22 zstd-compress, three cJSON). A retained deflateGetDictionary IR fragment demonstrates the missed branch: unused uninitialized definitions follow the ICmp, so source-adjacency fusion misses it; shared baseline DCE later removes those machine definitions. Syntactic counts are not eligibility or promised savings.

scope.placement: Target-specific bounded MIR selection after shared baseline DCE/SSA destruction and before allocation. Reuse existing instructions, terminators, generated operand facts and the unchanged allocation verifier. No change to DCE, its ordering or its attribution.
scope.boolean_branch: Only the final adjacent integer Cmp/CmpImm and Cset in a block followed by Tb of bit zero or Cb using that Cset destination. The Boolean must have exactly one definition and one use across the function; the flags have one definition and their one adjacent consumer. Remove only Cset and replace the existing branch by BCond using the same flags, original condition (inverted for a zero test), successors and edge arguments. Floating compares, flag-setting arithmetic, other bit tests, intervening instructions and live-out Boolean uses decline.
scope.interval: Only five adjacent instructions: CmpImm(f1,x,lo), Cset(a,f1,GE/HS), CmpImm(f2,x,hi), Cset(b,f2,LE/LS), Binary AND(r,a,b), with matching signedness, either Boolean input order, the identical W/X source and 0 <= lo <= hi <= 4095. Each flag and removed Boolean has one definition and one use. Replace by SUB tmp,x,#lo; CMP tmp,#(hi-lo); CSET r,LS. When lo=0 omit SUB. The temporary reuses the removed first Boolean's unique identity at the source register width; every reference to its old class is removed. The result retains its original GPR class. Do not generalize to OR, strict/reversed/mixed predicates, negative or wider endpoints, different values, extra users, intervening operations or CFG patterns.
scope.semantic_argument: For N=32/64 and nonnegative ordered imm12 endpoints, lo <= x <= hi is equivalent to unsigned((x-lo) mod 2^N) <= hi-lo, for either the admitted signed or unsigned comparisons. Signed negative inputs and values below lo fail the unsigned test; the interval length is strictly less than half the modulus. There is no source arithmetic insertion or deletion of a C UB obligation. Original internal flags and Boolean temporaries are unobservable after their sole uses. Final source result bits and control edges must agree.
scope.unchanged: No EvoIR, MIR opcode meaning, flags lifetime, interpreter, ABI, allocator, verifier, registry, certificate, fact lattice, alias or effect rule changes. No instruction motion, speculative arms, general CCMP or if-conversion. No new ISA operation or model slice.
scope.default: OFF. Kernel and frame-pointer protected profiles suppress the option. C2 remains excluded from the admitted cumulative arm.

interface.driver: Add controls to the duplicate-free --isel-opt list, canonical order constants,local,extensions,controls. Use the same parser in the public driver, native corpus hook and exact-IR adapter. Reject malformed, repeated and --check combinations; OFF bytes unchanged.
interface.patterns: Add two bounded rows to the existing target pattern generator/table with explicit live-value/edge and adjacent-flags contracts. Finite validation, not an N07 SMT proof. No new matcher framework or audit.
interface.telemetry: Existing producer-only selected/declined comments, with named reasons. Report interval and branch instruction removals separately, including when the interval output also feeds an eligible branch.
interface.spec: EvoMIR implementation-policy revision only; existing operation semantics unchanged.

red: Minimal exact-IR Boolean branch with unused uninitialized definitions after ICmp, derived from retained deflate IR; baseline emits CSET, controls removes it without removing or moving any observable operation.

Existing MIR interpreter and native before/after comparison for W/X input, both branch senses, all admitted comparison conditions and interval boundaries including 0, 1, 4095, equal endpoints, signed minima/maxima and wrapped below-lower-bound inputs.

Multiple definitions or uses of Boolean/flags, outgoing transport/other-block uses, different input/class/width/sign, inverted bounds, imm12 overflow, nonzero bit tests, FP producers, intervening memory/call/asm/fenv operations, masks and malformed shapes decline.
Cycles, edge copies, spills, alias-prone assignments, multiple returns and both OS targets retain valid allocation and correct branch relaxation/fallthrough.
Default identity, protected profile suppression, invalid option lists, all option parser combinations and controls with frame/constants/extensions/copy/reload options.
Interval selection followed by terminal branch selection has separate counts and preserves both edge values; a second pass is idempotent. No new UB or poison interpretation.

acceptance.native: 384 Darwin and 384 sealed Linux cases OFF/ON, serial; identical object twins, OFF byte hashes match C3, native outputs agree. Focused MIR and public Linux source tests must actually select each family, rather than count no-op corpus successes as pattern coverage.
acceptance.six_units: Freeze six A/B plans before measurements: fresh OFF, controls-only, and cumulative frame+C1+extensions+copy+reload+controls. Checked/unchecked separately; three compile observations and two object builds; unchanged source/IR/chain/bundle, original selected-TU harnesses, zero completed proof rejections or bundle failures.
acceptance.attribution: Existing S1/N01 object categories and producer counts. Keep branch/compare/compute changes separate from P0, guard, frame, DCE and previous selectors. Report C5-only and incremental cumulative savings versus C3.
acceptance.coverage: N02 70 admitted / 187 opaque and legacy source-bridge mismatch remain; no full application, kernel, latency, default or proof promotion.
gates: focused MIR/native/driver tests and existing touched Python tests
acceptance.stop: One frozen bounded implementation/cohort. Preserve zero savings or compile-bound misses; decline unsafe patterns rather than widen them. General CCMP and control restructuring outside this measured idiom remain unimplemented, not proved absent. Do not resample to erase a miss.

resources.retention: No new target/workspace/kernel tree or VM disk. Hash/measure and retire owned intermediate objects, preserving current OFF/cumulative baselines and compact evidence; record scoped disk delta.

claim_ceiling: Bounded opt-in selection of existing integer/control MIR operations, finite-validated only. No verified EqSat benefit, general CCMP/if-conversion, default admission, B1/B6 proof, or guarantee of the 1.4 target.
